component.name: OpenWorld
component.summary: Check your own photo or video against public FBI posters, on this device

description.p: Choose a photo or video you already have. OpenWorld looks for faces in it on this computer and compares them to a small, frozen pack of public FBI missing-person and wanted-person posters, with a locked cutoff. Nothing is uploaded, nobody is enrolled, and OpenWorld does not contact an agency or send a report.

A face past the cutoff is shown beside the poster with the frame it came from: “Possible candidate. Not an identification.” No candidate is not a clearance, and a stopped scan is Incomplete. Opening a poster’s FBI page goes through one confirmation.
This build carries demo posters made of synthetic markers. Real FBI photos stay off until the Fast bundle has a measured false-match curve.
